tools.name: lorcana_deck_check
tools.description: FREE Lorcana deck check: Core/Infinity legality, inks, inkable count. Paste a decklist ("4 Name - Version"). Checks 60+ cards, max 4 per card, max 2 ink colors and Core/Infinity legality; returns inkable count, card types, cost curve and goldfish tags. Data: Lorcast; always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: lorcana_opening_hand_odds
tools.description: FREE Lorcana opening hand odds for one card. Chance a card you run N copies of is in your opening 7 (60-card deck). (free, no payment)

tools.name: lorcana_draw_odds
tools.description: Lorcana draw sim: exact odds to draw your cards by turn N. Exact joint odds of drawing one or more cards (up to 6 groups) in the opening 7 and by each turn, on the play (no turn-1 draw) or draw. Costs $0.001 per call, paid with MPP on Tempo (send an MPP Payment credential in the Authorization header

tools.name: lorcana_ink_odds
tools.description: Lorcana ink odds: inkable cards needed to ink every turn. How many inkable cards you need to put a card in your inkwell every turn through turn N at your target probability, and your own deck's odds turn by turn. Exact hypergeometric. Costs $0.001 per call, paid with MPP on Tempo (send an MPP Paymen

tools.name: lorcana_goldfish
tools.description: Lorcana goldfish simulator for a pasted decklist. Seeded Monte Carlo goldfish: alter-hand mulligan, inking each turn, plays by cost, odds of inking every turn, ink spent per turn, and your goals ("draw/cast Elsa by turn 5"). Inkable and cost come from card data. Up to 20,000 games. Costs $0.003 per
